about.subtitle: Artificial intelligence at the service of your career. Stop searching, start finding.
about.context_p1: The job market has become a complex jungle. Candidates spend hours scrolling through dozens of sites, often to find offers that don't really match their expectations or are already filled.
about.context_p2: was born from a simple observation: job searching should be proactive and intelligent, not exhausting.
about.context_p3: By combining the power of ethical scraping and advanced recommendation algorithms, we've created a platform that doesn't just list offers, but
about.context_p3_end: your profile and connects you to the most relevant opportunities.
about.precision_desc: No more noise. Only offers that match your skills.
about.speed_desc: Automate your search and save precious hours every week.
about.privacy_desc: Your data belongs to you. No resale, no spam.

auto_apply.title: Auto-Apply Autopilot
auto_apply.desc: Upload your CV, complete your profile, and consent to automation. The bot submits forms when possible; many listings still need manual steps (external site, login, captcha).
auto_apply.legal_disclaimer: Job sites have their own terms. You remain responsible for complying with them. Seekra does not guarantee every listing can be automated. Always verify your application status with the employer.
auto_apply.consent_text: I authorize Seekra to submit applications on my behalf for offers I approve or that the autopilot processes, within plan limits.
auto_apply.platform_desc: Encrypted server-side when APPLY_SECRETS_KEY is set. Useful when a login is required.
auto_apply.upload_desc: Gemini AI will analyze it instantly.
auto_apply.running_now_msg: Launch order sent to the bot...
auto_apply.run_success: The bot started the search in background.
auto_apply.no_history_desc: Activate the bot and come back tomorrow. You will see here the list of companies we contacted for you.
